query:
UPDATE shipping_rates SET
             name             = COALESCE($2, name),
             price_amount     = COALESCE($3, price_amount),
             min_weight_g     = COALESCE($4, min_weight_g),
             max_weight_g     = $5,
             free_over_amount = $6,
             active           = COALESCE($7, active),
             position         = COALESCE($8, position),
             updated_at       = now()
         WHERE id = $1
